Title: General availability: Azure Cognitive Services Translator releases nine new languages

Body.Content:
Azure Cognitive Services Translator is releasing nine new languages for text translation: Albanian, Amharic, Armenian, Azeri, Khmer, Lao, Myanmar, Nepali, and Tigrinya. Text translation is now available in 83 different languages. Learn more in the Translator blog.

See more information on other languages that Translator supports.
